text: Split built-app startup time into stages with the existing perfLog marks
description: From Felix's trace notes (performance-recordings/about.md, 2026-10-20): the built app paints idea content at ~1.9-2.9 s; the backend answer arrives ~0.4-0.5 s after the request, and there is a visible gap between receiving the data and the populated view. Suspect order: App.vue runProjectRestore() and dataStore.loadProject() (meta/access, phases, ideas, local-cache check, then UI-state restore). Next step: correlate the perfLog marks with a few reloads of the built app under equal cache conditions and split time into cache read, meta/access, phase load, idea load and UI restore; then fix the largest stage. The dev build's extra ~2 s is module loading, not worth optimizing.

status.comment: Needs a running built app, and AGENTS.md forbids agents starting servers. Felix: either record three reloads of the built app (pnpm start) with the console's perfLog output saved, or allow the agent to start one vite preview on a spare port for this measurement.
